name: Pizza da Peppe
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizza da Peppe in Füssen**

Discover authentic Italian flair in the heart of the **Allgäu**! **Pizza da Peppe** in **Füssen** invites you to savor delicious, freshly baked pizzas in a cozy atmosphere. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a unique creation with local ingredients, every bite is a taste of Italy.

The friendly team at **Pizza da Peppe** takes pride in their handmade dough and high-quality toppings, ensuring a perfect balance of flavors. Enjoy your meal with a glass of fine Italian wine or a refreshing **San Pellegrino**—because the best pizza experience deserves the perfect pairing.

After your meal, take a short stroll to explore **Füssen**’s charming old town or relax by the picturesque **Forggensee**. Whether you're visiting with family, friends, or on a romantic getaway, **Pizza da Peppe** is the ideal spot for a memorable dining experience in the **Allgäu**.
